title: The draft-PR guard catches a PR create inside single quotes in an unquoted heredoc
why: In an unquoted heredoc fed to an interpreter (`python3 - <<EOF`), a body line `x = '$(gh pr create)'` is allowed. Bash runs that `$(...)` while it writes the body, because single quotes do not protect inside a heredoc. Same on main d70ebd14d (lane draft-pr-guard-text-false-alarm, 01:51 CST Nov 8). Decision draft-until-reviewed.
note: Fix: in an unquoted heredoc body, read `$(...)` and backticks as live whatever quotes surround them, and refuse a PR create found there. Red case first on the line above; control: the same line in a quoted heredoc (`<<'EOF'`) stays allowed. Built by lane draft-pr-guard-text-false-alarm (session_013NEJL232Ko7dmr4v3fmrvF) after #2087.
